overview: A task marketplace where people post jobs they need done and others browse, send offers, get matched, chat and leave reviews.
features: Sign in and build a profile with skills, service area and photo
Post a job with budget, category, location, date and photos
Search and filter jobs by keyword, category, price and location
Send an offer with a price, message and timeframe
Pick a worker and track the job from open to done
Chat inside each job between the two parties
Rate and review each other after the job is finished
